outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence images, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.

A single asterisk appears above the comparison bracket in the bar graph, but neither the image nor the caption states what significance threshold (e.g., P < 0.05) the asterisk represents. The caption only reports the exact P value (P = 0.0281) and the test used, but does not define the symbol itself.
Panel C consists of histology/fluorescence images and spatial expression plots with continuous color-scale legends; no significance symbols are present.
The GSEA enrichment plots report exact NES, FDR, and p values directly on each plot rather than using significance symbols, so no symbol definition is required.
The bar graph reports exact p values above each bar rather than using significance symbols, so no symbol definition is required.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
